note: Combat items that aren't worn (gear is equipment.json): kind material (whetstones, fragments, Repair Kits; stack 999), potion (HP/MP Potions; stack 99, `heals` hp or mp by their tier's number in classes/stats.json potions), agimat (`stat`: its stat; the item's level and slot lock are the item's own; stack 999 with the same stat, level and lock), cosmetic (doesn't stack), quest (a quest item: never sold, traded, dropped, taken apart or banked, one a slot, taken when it's handed over; Aling Nena's quest, 15 Oct 2026). bound: made bound (never traded or dropped). rarity: its name's colour (stats.json rarity). tier: stats.json gearTiers / potions.tiers (low…). icon 16x16, showcase 32x32, large 64x64. shop: sold at the sari-sari store, priced by stats.json (potion: potions.tiers[tier].kusing in Kusing, the Healing tab; whetstone / repairKit: currencies.kowensShop in Kowens, the Smithing tab). forge: what it does at the forge popup, for its tier's gear (whetstone: enhances; fragment: ten combine into its tier's whetstone; repairKit: repairs a broken item). consumable: used somewhere in the world, not from the bag (the Warren Ticket: at the Warren Gate; stack 99; shop ticket = the Dungeons tab, priced in classes/dungeons.json warrens.ticket.sources.shop).
